passages.context: The complete English responsa, including the aim of re-establishing a single and identical prayer, the parish-church condition that it be established that use of another church, oratory, or chapel is impossible, the restriction of preconciliar ritual books to the 1952 Rituale for erected personal parishes, and the fraternal-dialogue procedure for priests who deny the validity and legitimacy of the liturgical reform.
passages.notes: The complete delivery was structurally inspected; no comparison with a printed Acta witness is claimed.

alternate_titles: Responsa ad dubia on certain provisions of the Apostolic Letter Traditionis custodes
work.author: Congregation for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments
work.description: The Congregation's responses of 4 December 2021 to eleven questions on the application of Traditionis custodes, with explanatory notes, published after Francis approved publication on 18 November 2021, including the conditions for use of parish churches, the restriction of the older Pontificale and Rituale, and the treatment of priests who deny the validity and legitimacy of the liturgical reform.
work.title: Responsa ad dubia on Traditionis custodes
